name: 📊 Weekly Report
description: Every Monday morning (or whenever you say): gather what the office did — cards done, spend, workflow runs, meetings — have the Director write the report, and deliver it to your channel and a file.

commands.name: setup
commands.desc: Install the report workflow and schedule it (default Monday 09:00)

commands.name: run
commands.desc: Write a report now, covering the last N days (default 7)

commands.name: gather
commands.desc: Just the raw numbers, as text
